This description of the blue 'Final Accuracy' line is incorrect. The value at an initial confidence of 0.87 is approximately 0.91. While there is a value of ~0.92 at x=0.82 and x=0.92, neither location corresponds to 'around 0.87', and the key feature in that region is a dip to ~0.91, not 0.92.

errors.evidence: This description of the orange 'Δ Accuracy' line is factually incorrect. The first local minimum is at x=0.86 with a value of approximately 0.15, not 0.08. Following this, the value at x=0.87 rises sharply to about 0.35, not 0.18.
The description fails to mention the distinct line styles (solid, dashed, dash-dot) which are used in the legend and plot to differentiate the three data series.
